title: Physics in Clojure - Colin Smith
summary: Colin Smith introduces Structure and Interpretation of Classical Mechanics and his Clojure port, sicmutils. He shows how higher-order functions and a symbolic algebra system can represent Lagrangian mechanics.
why: Recommended as the best introduction to SICM and sicmutils and a showcase of what such symbolic systems can do.

quote.text: The Strange Loop talk [3] is a good showcase of the power and simplicity of these kind of systems.
